name: Leah Kramer
bio:
Leah Kramer, a talented tattoo artist at Mind's Eye Tattoo in Allentown, PA, stands out with her exceptional skill in watercolor and trashpolka styles. Her professionalism is evident in every piece of art she creates, ensuring each client's vision is intricately brought to life on their skin. Sponsored by Industry Inks, Leah is a dedicated artist who maintains a high standard of work and client satisfaction. Please direct inquiries to mindseyeink@yahoo.com, as she kindly requests not to use direct messages for booking or questions.
